subject: Third-party roster and delegated processing scope — evidence and clarifications
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novushealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novushealth.com
Date: 2026-12-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: subprocessor roster + delegated scope details

Hi Monica —

Thanks for the call this morning. As part of our SIG-Lite assessment we need the following so our vendor-risk team can close out the intake: 1) current subprocessor roster (production and staging), 2) a short map showing which subprocessors process customer data vs. internal telemetry, and 3) any declared delegations where Redwood allows a subprocessor to further subcontract.

Can you provide a CSV roster and a one-page PDF that highlights delegated processing relationships? Ideally by EOD next Tuesday 12/28.

Cheers,
Elaine Park
Vendor Risk Manager, Novus Health
[Novus logo]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-21T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor roster + delegated scope details

Hi Elaine —

Thanks for the note. We can definitely get that to you. High-level clarifications before we compile the artifacts: 1) Our roster will include production, non-prod (staging/ci), and historical entries flagged with residency; 2) We classify "customer data" in the roster as any payloads that include PII or customer-owned datasets (we'll mark columns accordingly); 3) Redwood uses a tiered delegation model — we only permit a second-tier subcontractor when a direct subprocessor cannot provide a required capability, and those are explicitly listed in the delegated map.

We'll attach a CSV and a one-page PDF callout. Quick ask — do you want the exported CSV to include KMS key owner columns and whether the subprocessor has direct-access or only telemetry access?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security & Trust — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_subprocessor_roster_2026-12.csv (csv)]
[Attachment: delegated_processing_map_novus_2026-12.pdf (pdf)]

From: David Cho <david.cho@novushealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@novushealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-22T08:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor roster + delegated scope details

Monica —

KMS key ownership column would be helpful. Also can you add a short flag per row for whether the subprocessor handles: (a) tokenized patient data, (b) non-identifiable telemetry, or (c) configuration metadata only. Our procurement team needs that for the privacy maturity scoring.

Thanks,
David
Vendor Risk Analyst, Novus Health

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: David Cho <david.cho@novushealth.com>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@novushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-28T13:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor roster + delegated scope details

Hi David / Elaine —

Please find attached the roster CSV and a single-page delegated-scope PDF. Notes on the artifacts:
- redwood_subprocessor_roster_2026-12.csv: columns = name, service, environment (prod/non-prod), country_of_residency, processes_customer_data (yes/no), data_category (tokenized patient data / telemetry / config), kms_key_owner (Redwood / Customer / Subprocessor), direct_access (yes/no), last_attestation_date. Rows with transitive subcontractors are suffixed with "::sub" and include the parent subprocessor in parent_column.
- delegated_processing_map_novus_2026-12.pdf: high-level diagram showing allowed subcontracting paths and the control rationale.

Delta vs. prior roster: two new entries (EdgeCache Inc. for global CDN logs, and QuantizeOps LLC for quantization toolchain support). Both are limited to telemetry-only processing and do not have access to KMS keys.

If you want, Ben can follow up with a brief walkthrough (15 min) of the CSV and the delegation policy next week.

Best,
Monica
Security & Trust — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_subprocessor_roster_2026-12.csv (csv)]
